mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than the market average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.25% signals an imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate combined with rising payrolls (indicating labor market recovery) signals improving economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in high UNRATE and rising PAYEMS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansion, strong housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in late-cycle expansion periods with high HOUST are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day returns in periods with INDPRO < 95.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High real sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in high RSAFS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate and high unemployment rate signals a monetary stimulus-driven recovery, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, high inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates aggressive rate hikes, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day returns in monetary tightening cycles with high CPIAUCSL are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
